decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template has not appeared on the website since 2018, which suggests little uptake, but it costs almost nothing to keep and still fits shop hosting, so the cheap option stays open while its value remains doubtful.
The responsive template has disappeared from view and shows no sign of value, but keeping it costs very little, so it stays for now even though abandonment is about as likely as not.
Premium support is central to the firm's agency-focused, round-the-clock service model and earns recurring revenue at low incremental cost, so keeping it is clearly justified.

The version management tool builds on the firm's tooling that cuts recurring operational work, so it adds strategic value to the platform and deserves continued commitment despite little recent visibility.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship of the firm's strategic direction and sits close to its core business, so the firm would build on it rather than abandon it.
